title: Add separate Category field and filter section alongside Shape filter

requirements.summary: Update BulkProductUpload to include separate category input field alongside shape field
acceptanceCriteria: Category input field is displayed for each product in bulk upload
Category field is independent from shape field
Auto-copy functionality includes category when enabled
Category value is sent to backend when creating products

file_operations.description: Add a category input field to each product entry in the bulk upload form. Update the ProductEntry type to include a category field of type string. Add a text input for category alongside the existing shape input. Ensure the auto-fill from first entry functionality copies the category value when enabled. Update the handleSubmit function to include category when calling addProduct mutation (using the category field from the backend interface).

requirements.summary: Update ProductManagementTable to display category column and support inline editing
acceptanceCriteria: Category column is displayed in the product management table
Category can be edited inline with save/cancel controls
Category dropdown or input allows selecting/entering category values
Category updates are saved to backend correctly

file_operations.description: Add a Category column to the table displaying product.category. Implement inline editing for the category field similar to how name and shape are edited. Add a text input that appears when editing category. Update the handleSave function to include the category field when calling updateProduct mutation. Ensure the category can be updated independently from other fields.

requirements.summary: Add separate Category filter section in Marketplace page alongside Shape filter
acceptanceCriteria: Category filter section is visually separate from Shape filter section
All unique category values from products are displayed as filter tabs
Category filter tabs are clickable and toggle selection state
Multiple category filters can be selected simultaneously
Category filters work independently from shape filters

file_operations.description: Extract all unique category values from the products array using a Set. Add a new Category filter section in the page header (similar to the existing Shape filter section) that displays all unique categories as clickable filter tabs. Add state management for selectedCategories (array of strings) similar to selectedShapes. Implement toggle functionality for category filters allowing multiple selections. Style the Category filter section to be visually distinct from but aligned with the Shape filter section. Ensure both filter sections are displayed side by side or in separate rows in the header area.

requirements.summary: Update Marketplace filter logic to support filtering by both shape and category independently
acceptanceCriteria: Products are filtered by both shape and category selections
If no shape filters are selected, all shapes are shown (filtered only by category)
If no category filters are selected, all categories are shown (filtered only by shape)
If both filters are selected, products must match both criteria
Filtered results update all product sections (featured, most viewed, best selling, newest)

file_operations.description: Update the filteredProducts calculation logic to apply both shape and category filters. If selectedShapes is empty, skip shape filtering. If selectedCategories is empty, skip category filtering. If both have selections, products must match at least one selected shape AND at least one selected category. Apply the combined filter to all product sections: featuredProducts, mostViewedProducts, bestSellingProducts, and newestProducts. Ensure the filtering logic uses product.category field from the backend interface.

requirements.summary: Update ProductCard to display both shape and category information
acceptanceCriteria: Both shape and category are displayed on product cards
Shape and category are visually distinguishable from each other
Layout accommodates both fields without cluttering the card design

file_operations.description: Add display of product.category alongside the existing product.shape display. Use distinct styling or labels (e.g., 'Shape: {shape}' and 'Category: {category}') to make them visually distinguishable. Position both fields in the card layout without cluttering the design, perhaps using a row with two columns or stacked layout with clear separation. Ensure the category field is displayed using product.category from the Product type.

requirements.summary: Update ProductDetailView to display both shape and category fields
acceptanceCriteria: Shape is displayed in product detail view
Category is displayed in product detail view as a separate field
Both fields are clearly labeled and distinguishable

file_operations.description: Add a separate display section for product.category in the product detail modal alongside the existing shape display. Use clear labels such as 'Shape:' and 'Category:' to distinguish the fields. Ensure both fields are visible in the modal layout without overlap. Reference product.category from the Product type passed as a prop.

requirements.summary: Update React Query hooks to handle category field in product data structures
acceptanceCriteria: useProducts hook returns products with category field
useCreateProduct mutation includes category parameter
useUpdateProduct mutation supports category updates
TypeScript types are updated to include category field

file_operations.description: Update the useCreateProduct mutation to accept a category parameter in the mutationFn and pass it to actor.addProduct (the backend interface already includes category as the 8th parameter). Update the useUpdateProduct mutation to accept an optional category parameter and pass it to actor.updateProduct. Verify that the Product type from backend.d.ts already includes the category field (it does according to the backend-interface). No TypeScript type changes needed in this file since types are imported from backend.d.ts.
